proposed_from.topic: Population success certificates, a sharp failure frontier, and adaptive uncertainty for GENE-style order optimization. Fix support-closed compact causally minimal restricted additive-noise models with smooth mechanisms, independent innovation densities positive on support interiors, and the stated Condition 19 configurations. Define the exact alpha=1 population-oracle analogue of GENE Equation (6) from conditional correlation ratios and exact characteristic-kernel residual-dependence labels. On the subclass M_pair(d), whose weak components are isolated vertices or single directed edges and whose primitive forward and reverse signal ratios satisfy rho_forward_uv > (d-1) rho_reverse_uv / d, prove that every non-topological order has a reversal-correcting insertion with a uniform positive gain, every insertion-local maximizer is topological, and best-improvement search followed by residual-independence pruning recovers the labelled DAG from every start with finite oracle-query bounds. Prove by an explicit smooth six-node nonlinear witness that this local certificate is strictly weaker than the global reversal-monotone premise of Li et al. Theorem 4.3, while making no recovery claim for their full nonlinear class or their released finite-sample neural-network and p-value implementation. Give the quadratic two-node positive-gain witness. For every eta in (0,1/2), construct an explicitly parameterized nonempty relatively open bivariate identifiable family, including a nonempty relatively open non-affine subfamily, on which the wrong order is the unique global and insertion-local maximizer by more than eta, and prove that 1/2 is the universal sharp supremum of this advantage. Give cross-fitted simultaneous conditional-risk and residual-HSIC bands with set-valued independence decisions: exact-path separation yields graph-set coverage, whereas singleton recovery requires all-compatible-query separation and resolved score and HSIC margins. Retain the generic ambient-dimensional rates and prove a pairing-agnostic matching-adaptive branch with intrinsic one-dimensional regression rate 3/7, risk exponent 6/7, sufficient singleton order log(M_d/alpha) times max of (d/delta_pair)^2 and lambda^(-7/3), and no ambient-dimensional elbow. Treat the released Sachs workflow only as an audit case. This topic delivers a sufficient structural success region and a sharp existential failure frontier; it does not claim a non-tautological necessary-and-sufficient maximal classification of general GENE landscapes, minimax-optimal rates, or a refutation of Li et al. conditional theorem.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The root claim is a non-definitional implication from the structural product law and the primitive inequality \(\rho^{\to}_{uv}>(d-1)\rho^{\leftarrow}_{uv}/d\) to a positive correcting insertion. The six-node cosine--quadratic witness satisfies the primitive condition while reversing the score ordering required by Li et al. (2025, Theorem 4.3), with limits \(2\) and \(1+4/5+5/6\) for explicit orders. Peters et al.'s published positive-density Condition 19 identification result motivates, but is distinct from, the compact-support adaptations used here: relative-interior positive innovation densities, interior-section Condition 19 configurations, and positive-parent-law-measure nonconstancy. Peters et al.'s Proposition 17 supplies only the pointwise nonconstancy characterization; the strengthened formulation ensures that the relevant parent effect is nonconstant on a positive-law interior set for the compact identification bridge. Support closure, connected relative-interior fibers, local positivity, and null boundaries complete that bridge. The HSIC theorem separately distinguishes Pfister-supported bounded continuous characteristic kernels from the nonstandard residual-coordinate Lipschitz premise used only for its \(a_n\) perturbation term. This yields a field-level sufficient theorem, a theorem-level strict comparator separation, and inference tied to primitive gain and pruning margins.

seed_details.anchor: pmlr-v267-li25bx, Equation (6), Theorem 4.3, Appendix C, and Sections 1 and 6
seed_details.opportunity: Derive an exact traversed-block gain identity and characterize the maximal locally navigable ANM subclass by equivalent primitive and observable finite inequalities.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Li et al.'s use of the assumed implication from lower reversal count to higher fitness by an explicit cancellation of all score terms outside an insertion block.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for additive-noise order scores with correlation ratios, residual independence, insertion local optima, and GENE citations found no theorem for this target--method pair.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: this is immediate from GENE because its theorem already proves greedy recovery. Rebuttal: GENE assumes a global latent reversal ranking and never derives a single Equation (6) gain sign from mechanisms or observables.
seed_details.burned_reason: The only field-scoped angle exhausted bounded repair; any renewed field attempt requires a genuine D-1.2 re-anchor.

seed_details.anchor: reisach2023scale, Sections 3, 5, and 6; pmlr-v267-li25bx, Equation (6) and Section 6
seed_details.opportunity: Lift the rare separated-component limiting experiment to a relatively open smooth positive-density identifiable ANM family with a strict wrong-order local optimum.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Reisach et al.'s chain variance lower bound by two directional conditional-risk bounds and preserve nonzero reverse-residual HSIC after smoothing.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches pairing smooth additive-noise identifiability with wrong-order local maxima of hybrid \(R^2\)--independence scores found no collision.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: a separated mixture merely recreates Hoyer et al.'s disconnected-support reversible example. Rebuttal: the required density is positive, the reverse residual must be strictly dependent, and the trap inequality must persist on a relative-open parameter region.

seed_details.anchor: pfister2018dhsic, Section 5.2, Theorem E.2, and Proposition E.3; shekhar2023permutationfree, Theorems 6 and 7 and Section 9
seed_details.opportunity: Construct simultaneous cross-fitted bands for every normalized conditional risk and fitted-residual HSIC queried by adaptive insertion search, with set-valued independence calls.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the pointwise exact-residual comparison by a fold-conditional Lipschitz perturbation bound unioned over all predecessor sets and random risk denominators.
seed_details.destination_search: The fitted-residual and cross-HSIC papers treat one test or a fixed family, not the joint GENE risk--dependence query universe.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: Bonferroni plus sample splitting is routine. Rebuttal: simultaneous control must also propagate learned residual perturbations and normalized conditional-risk error through adaptively selected insertion gains while refusing to accept a zero HSIC from nonrejection.

seed_details.anchor: prior proposal eid_ganm_innovation_atomic_partition_v1, Proposition on characteristic-modulus atomicity and its technical limitation
seed_details.opportunity: Characterize the exact dependence threshold below which replacing GENE's binary indicator by continuous characteristic-kernel HSIC preserves every insertion-gain sign.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace one-sided conditional-modulus falsification by a finite sign-stability analysis of kernel cross-covariances inside each insertion block.
seed_details.destination_search: No paper located an HSIC threshold that preserves the local maxima of the GENE score.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: continuity makes threshold preservation automatic. Rebuttal: the exact indicator is discontinuous and a threshold can create or erase local maxima unless both score and dependence margins enter the critical threshold.

seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: near-zero signals always imply impossibility. Rebuttal: a sharp experiment-specific modulus in the joint gain--HSIC geometry would be new, but constructing a legal least-favorable ANM pair is less feasible than the selected bands.

seed_details.destination_search: Existing Sachs reanalyses compare graphs or allow cycles but do not audit the exact GENE population terms.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: this is only an empirical replication. Rebuttal: the falsification map is theorem-driven and separates incompatible assumptions, but the data audit is not strong enough to serve as the mathematical kernel.

seed_details.opportunity: Characterize when a GENE insertion ascent projects to a weakly decreasing covered-arrow walk and exhibit the observable frontier where the two local searches diverge.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace sparsity-monotone minimal-independence maps by score-bearing complete-order states and compare their move-induced predecessor sets.
seed_details.destination_search: No paper directly compares these two move graphs under an ANM risk--independence score.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: both are permutation searches, so one is a reformulation of the other. Rebuttal: their state spaces, allowed paths, and objectives differ, but a closed observable divergence frontier was not evident from the sources and the seed was dropped.
